    # Recolor each of the four repeated motif groups by its shape.

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0 if v == 8 else v for v in row] for row in grid]
    unseen = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8}
    comps = []
    while unseen:
        start = min(unseen)
        stack = [start]
        unseen.remove(start)
        comp = []
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            comp.append((r, c))
            for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                p = (r+dr,c+dc)
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p)
                    stack.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    # Component connectivity alone merges adjacent motifs, so identify motif cells
    # by the observed template's repeating block/triomino arrangement.
